cards.anchor: Correctly identify and cite the seeded initiating failure from actually viewed evidence within 12 simulated minutes, with at most one full-suite rerun and preservation of the initiating record. This is a proposed synthetic exercise, with no claimed real productivity benefit.
cards.burden: Instantiate the stipulated logs, two-slot history and clock on paper or a spreadsheet; conceal the scoring sheet procedurally. Record all actions, charged minutes, selected run, visible interval, full-rerun count, committed citation and retained history. A retained full view costs one stipulated minute; a fresh full rerun plus full view costs five. No diagnosis-commit cost or cognitive effort is supplied, so do not silently assign either a measured value.
cards.construction: Hypothesis: make inspected evidence coverage the prerequisite for commitment. Reset to completed run-1 at time zero, forbid new full-suite execution, select run-1 and inspect lines 1-90. Require the exercising role to commit a component/message/run citation before the scoring role checks it. Preserve run-1. If a B7 focused view is inspected, treat its line-2 prerequisite message only as a routing clue to inspect retained evidence; it does not establish the omitted B2 configuration message.
cards.defeat: The candidate fails if no supported initiating citation is committed within the budget, if commitment cites records not actually viewed, or if the initiating record is lost. A demonstrated indispensable context gap in retained evidence, resolved by the fresh-run control, favors the necessity rival. A B2 configuration citation on the negative fixture is invalid and exposes possible answer guessing; it cannot count as root diagnosis. Equal valid success in retained and fresh arms contradicts fresh-execution necessity for this fixture but establishes no human decision mechanism.
cards.mutation: Replace the proposed fresh-full-suite prerequisite with an inspected-record prerequisite. At the B7 boundary, traverse from the visible prerequisite hint to retained full-view evidence instead of inferring the absent root message or automatically launching a full suite. The change is an untested operating hypothesis.
cards.prediction_candidate: On the seeded fixture, the retained arm is predicted to commit B2, CONFIG missing region, run-1, line 8 after one charged view minute, with zero full-suite reruns and the record retained. The fresh arm should expose the same initiating message in run-2 after five charged minutes. On the negative fixture, neither arm may validly claim that seeded B2 configuration root. A B7-only view cannot support the configuration citation.
cards.prediction_rival: If fresh full-suite execution supplies indispensable context even with the retained initiating record visible, the retained arm should fail to produce a valid complete citation or identify a specific missing context, while the fresh arm should supply that context and succeed. Identical visible records and supported success without fresh execution would contradict this necessity claim within the unchanged deterministic fixture.
cards.probe: Run separate reset tabletop repetitions with identical diagnosis demand, fixture and commitment-before-scoring rule. Arm A prohibits fresh full-suite execution and views retained run-1 in full. Arm B executes exactly one full rerun and views run-2 in full. Compare scored citations, costs and record retention. Repeat each condition with the concealed negative fixture. In a separate boundary check, log the B7 focused output before any commitment, then view retained run-1 in full; score whether the configuration citation depends on actually exposing its message. Do not treat mere saved time or correct guessing as success. These exercises have not been performed here.
cards.rival: Fresh full-suite execution provides indispensable diagnostic context that inspected retained evidence cannot provide, even when the initiating message is visible. The stipulated operator trace alone does not establish this claim or the reasons for its rerun request.
unknowns: Whether an exercising role actually inspects, commits and passes scoring remains untested; feasibility is not observed success.
Within-packet concealment is procedural and may fail, motivating the negative-fixture and viewed-record checks.
Diagnosis commitment time and real cognitive effort are unspecified; all action costs are stipulated.
The reasons for the supplied action sequence are unobserved. This probe does not establish a visibility-driven recurrent rerun loop or population behavior.
Nondeterministic, changing or multiple-root failures may favor fresh execution; live CI and analyst timing are unavailable.
